cards.signin: {{cast.user}} signs in to {{cast.company}}'s portal through the portal's own form; the password goes only to PingFederate.
cards.dcr: {{cast.agent}} enrols as a client of {{cast.company}} with an initial access token; an anonymous enrolment is refused.
cards.rar: {{cast.agent}} asks for one specific payment to {{cast.payee}}, described in full, and {{cast.user}} approves exactly that.
cards.ciba: {{cast.agent}} wants {{cast.user}}'s consent before sharing a result; the request lands on {{cast.user}}'s phone, not in the agent's window.
cards.dpop: {{cast.agent}} proves with its own key on every call that it is the holder of its token.
cards.tokenExchange: A request from {{cast.user}} passes through {{cast.agent}} to {{cast.serviceWord}}, and the token records both hops.
cards.userinfo: The portal confirms who {{cast.user}} is by asking PingFederate with {{cast.user}}'s token.
cards.piflow: The portal drives PingFederate's sign-in through an API and shows its own screens.
cards.par: {{cast.agent}}'s request is pushed to PingFederate up front and referred to by a one-time handle.
cards.pkce: A stolen authorization code cannot be redeemed without the verifier {{cast.agent}} never sent.
